correctness.rationale: The precise signature is equality plus a ternary C(x,y,z) with repeated triples counted collinear, and quantifier rank <=5. The recursive extension-profile T_i on ordered tuples is equivalent to a five-round Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé game, where multiplicities of extension types are irrelevant. For four-point caps only the six pair-line singleton extensions, none, and up to three opposite-pair crossings remain; the planar affine coordinates (0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(u,v) yield opposite-pair parallelities v=1,u=1,u+v=0. In odd fields >=5 the planar possible crossing-cardinalities are 1,2,3; higher dimension adds 0. In even fields >=8 the planar and higher-dimensional choices are 0,2,3; neither can have exactly one. Lower small fields s=2,3,4 were checked by affine-basis and fifth-point availability arguments, making exactly nine rank-five classes and sharp maximum smallest representative size 5^3=125. I independently enumerated planar caps in F3,F5,F7 and implemented F4 arithmetic: F3 cap pair-lines cover all nine points; in F4 120 caps have 0 crossings covering all 16 points, and 720 caps have 2 crossings. These agree with the dimension-splitting proof; the conclusion for arbitrary prime powers is from the coordinate identities and counting, not finite interpolation.
